evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the user-facing error message ('Invalide amount') in the utility module. Follow the repository-memory skill when deciding whether anything from this task should be persisted as repository memory.
evals.expected_output: The typo is fixed and no repository memory of any kind is written, because a typo fix fails the promotion gate
expectations: The typo in src/util/format.js is fixed
No new file of any name is created and no file other than src/util/format.js is modified; in particular no AGENT_MEMORY.md or AGENT_LOG.md appears anywhere
If memory promotion is considered at all, it is declined because a typo fix is not durable, non-obvious repository knowledge

evals.prompt: Add a rate limit of five renewals per minute per session to token renewal. An AGENT_MEMORY.md exists in src/auth; follow the repository-memory skill to decide what of it you can rely on.
evals.expected_output: The capsule is treated as unverifiable memory yielding no trusted content, renewal is mapped by direct investigation of the code, and the rate limit covers both renewal sites
expectations: The capsule is not treated as verified memory: the workspace offers no way to establish its state, and the agent does not manufacture trust by pointing the checker at HEAD or another local ref
The agent independently establishes where token renewal happens and identifies src/routes/refresh.js as a second renewal site, rather than accepting the capsule's single-owner claim
The rate limit accounts for both renewal sites

evals.prompt: Scheduled jobs sometimes fire twice around daylight-saving changes. Find and fix the root cause. Follow the repository-memory skill: if the investigation surfaces durable, non-obvious knowledge about this codebase, persist it the way the skill prescribes.
evals.expected_output: The mixed timestamp formats are fixed so rescheduling goes through lib/clock, and a minimal AGENT_MEMORY.md capsule colocated with the affected code records the cross-module timestamp invariant with valid scope and evidence
expectations: The root cause is traced across files: jobs/store.js persists nextRun through lib/clock.serialize (zone-less local time) while jobs/scheduler.js reschedules with toISOString, so the same field carries two formats that diverge around DST

An AGENT_MEMORY.md is created colocated with the affected code, its frontmatter declares scope and evidence, and its body of roughly 150 words or less records the invariant that persisted timestamps must flow through lib/clock
The capsule is the only memory file created: a small delta shipped with the fix, not a per-directory summary sweep
